items.title: NVIDIA’s New GeForce Game Ready Driver Is Optimized for World of Warcraft Forever and DLSS 5’s Hogwarts Legacy and War Thunder Patches
items.summary: NVIDIA has released a new GeForce Game Ready driver, version 621.14, which is optimized for the imminent launch of World of Warcraft Forever, as well as tomorrow's debut of DLSS 5 in Hogwarts Legacy and next week's DLSS 5 integration in War Thunder. World of Warcraft Forever, which opens its gates in just a few hours, does not include any DLSS technologies. However, it supports NVIDIA Reflex, which helps reduce latency in Blizzard's MMORPG, and the game is also playable on NVIDIA's new RTX Spark

confirmed_facts.text: Last but not least, this GeForce Game Ready driver is already optimized for War Thunder's upcoming Eagle's Shadow update, which will add official DLSS 5 support to the game.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Last but not least, this GeForce Game Ready driver is already optimized for War Thunder's upcoming Eagle's Shadow update, which will add official DLSS 5 support to the game.
